analysis:
The two units are head-text excerpts of CHANGELOG.md, lines 3638-4068. This is documentation with no executable code, and the diff excerpt shows only the v0.10.10 candidate header and rollout notes added near the top (head lines 11-39). Those added lines are not among the supplied units, so I could not examine them. I checked the visible historical entries for any statement that contradicts or invalidates the canonical threat model.

Relevant entries stay consistent with the model. The T-041 SSD prefix-cache notes state a 30-minute TTL, an environment override that can only shorten it, HMAC-keyed names, and a stable epoch that is not a purge primitive. The frozen legacy MDM cohort entries describe fail-closed behavior and require App Attest for new identities, which matches TB-011, T-052 and T-054. The cache-key stripping entry says caller `user`, `metadata` and `prompt_cache_key` are removed from provider-bound bodies, and this matches T-041's statement that caller values do not participate in cache scope.

The changelog also records that the unauthenticated earnings lookup was removed (T-031) and that attestation challenges now fail closed.

I found no concrete regression or new attack surface in these units, and no threat-model gap caused by them. Two open questions remain. The v0.10.10 waitlist and approval gating for sandbox setup and cluster pairing (TB-013, TB-014, T-061 and T-062) sits in the added header lines. The corresponding code and the coordinator waitlist API are outside the supplied evidence, so the integration pass should check them if the head-side code changes are in scope.
